features.relation: validator features are a strict subset of the ensemble features (not disjoint)
features.validator_model: LightGBM, 400 trees, depth 6, lr 0.05, class_weight=balanced, seed = training seed + 777, trained on real FIT rows only

hypotheses.H1: No GAN-based ensemble (ens_cgan, ens_wgan, ens_hyb) has a higher mean test macro-F1 than BOTH ens_cw and ens_smote.
hypotheses.H2: ens_hyb + Zero-Trust is not significantly more often correct than ens_smote (exact McNemar on binary correctness, Holm over the comparison family) in a majority of seeds.
hypotheses.H3: Zero-Trust recovers fewer than 10% of eligible high-confidence benign errors (attacks labelled Normal with confidence >= 0.85).
hypotheses.H4: The binary-error correlation (phi) between the validator and ens_hyb exceeds 0.5 on the test partition.
